# Paradise Ventures — Human Design Knowledge Layer
# Author: Daniel Klotz
# Primary domain: https://paradise.ventures
# Mirror (GitHub Pages): https://amosstrategy.github.io/trade-Strat-1/

> Institutional knowledge about Human Design as a mechanical, verifiable framework.
> Research project (ongoing). Interactive app nearly ready; proband test phase planned.
> Languages: German (primary) and English.

## About

Paradise Ventures publishes structured Human Design knowledge for people, teams, and AI systems.
Content is written by Daniel Klotz (Koh Phangan, Thailand). The approach treats Human Design as a
calculation framework backed by Swiss Ephemeris — not as vague spirituality or medical advice.

Coaching and readings complement the knowledge base; they do not replace it.

## Core topics (Q→A optimized)

### What is Paradise Ventures Human Design?
A research-led project building verifiable HD calculations (Swiss Ephemeris), everyday readings,
collective "weather" (transits), and team fields (Penta). Author: Daniel Klotz.

### Is this medical or psychological treatment?
No. All content is for self-reflection and education only. See Haftungsausschluss / Disclaimer.

### How is the chart calculated?
Swiss Ephemeris in the browser; gate line positions follow standard HD wheel mapping.
Details: /wissen/methodik/

### What is "Emotion als Sensor"?
A hypothesis that emotional waves (especially in defined Solar Plexus) function as timing sensors
for decisions — explored in research, not clinically proven.

### What is the Big Five / IPIP integration?
Johnson IPIP-NEO-120 (Public Domain, full 120 items, 30 facets — no short form) in /app/ tab «Big Five».
HD feature vector + export for proband research — exploratory, not validated mapping.
Scoring and export require all 120 answers.
Details: /wissen/forschung/big-five/

### What is Zeitqualität / collective weather?
Daily transit overlay on your fixed design — like weather forecast for decision timing.
